name: Question 18
problem:
$$
a=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,P=\frac{1}{17}[\begin{aligned}{p}_{11} & {p}_{12} & {p}_{13} \\ {p}_{21} & {p}_{22} & {p}_{23} \\ {p}_{31} & {p}_{32} & {p}_{33}\end{aligned}]
$$

Given that the vector $a$ above spans ${S}^{⊥},$ and that $P$ is the orthogonal projection matrix of ${R}^{3}$ onto the subspace $S$, what is the value of ${p}_{11}+{p}_{23}?$
worked_solution:
First, we find the orthogonal projection matrix onto ${S}^{⊥}=\text{Span}{a}.$

Using the formula for the orthogonal projection matrix

$$
{P}_{{S}^{⊥}}=a({a}^{T}\,a)^{-1}{a}^{T},
$$

we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{{S}^{⊥}} & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{aligned}]{([\begin{aligned}-3 & 2 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{aligned}])}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}-3 & 2 & -2\end{aligned}] \\  & ={17}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 & 2 & -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{17}[\begin{aligned}9 & -6 & 6 \\ -6 & 4 & -4 \\ 6 & -4 & 4\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Recall that ${P}_{S}+{P}_{{S}^{⊥}}=I.$ Therefore, 

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{S} & =I-{P}_{{S}^{⊥}} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]-\frac{1}{17}[\begin{aligned}9 & -6 & 6 \\ -6 & 4 & -4 \\ 6 & -4 & 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{17}[\begin{aligned}8 & 6 & -6 \\ 6 & 13 & 4 \\ -6 & 4 & 13\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, ${p}_{11}+{p}_{23}=8+4=12.$

Question 18

a=[−32−2],P=117[p11p12p13p21p22p23p31p32p33] Given that the vector a above spans S⊥, and that P is the orthogonal projection matrix of R3 onto the subspace S, what is the value of p11+p23?

a
12
b
19
c
21
d
−2
e
2
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we find the orthogonal projection matrix onto S⊥=Span{a}.

Using the formula for the orthogonal projection matrix

PS⊥=a(aTa)−1aT,

we obtain the following:

PS⊥=[−32−2]([−32−2][−32−2])−1[−32−2]=17−1[−32−2][−32−2]=117[9−66−64−46−44]

Recall that PS+PS⊥=I. Therefore,

PS=I−PS⊥=[100010001]−117[9−66−64−46−44]=117[86−66134−6413].

Finally, p11+p23=8+4=12.
